module_summary: Trip counter wrapping a delta counter: accumulates delta_i when enabled, compares count to bound_i, and auto-clears on the trip cycle.

anchors.name: q_o
anchors.why: Current count value from delta counter, compared against bound

anchors.name: trip_o
anchors.why: Trip pulse when count hits bound while enabled; also clears counter

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Increment enable for counter and trip qualification

anchors.name: bound_i
anchors.why: Terminal count bound compared with q_o

anchors.name: delta_i
anchors.why: Step size added to counter each enabled cycle

anchors.name: clr_i
anchors.why: Synchronous clear request ORed with trip into counter clear

groups.name: delta_counter
groups.description: Delta-step counter cleared by clr_i or trip

groups.name: bound_compare
groups.description: Compares count to bound, generates last and trip flags
